verdict.rationale: The evidence gives only indirect signs of cross-platform operation. OTP needs no client software and works anywhere a password can be typed, and Yubico documents YubiKey support over USB and NFC on Android and over NFC on iOS. Nothing explicitly covers desktop OS or browser compatibility, and no compatibility catalog of supported services appears anywhere. Missing for 10: published catalog of supported services, explicit OS/browser compatibility matrix, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-OS/browser use.

support.subject: As a power user, the key works across my operating systems and browsers, with a published compatibility catalog of supported services

citations.quote: No client software needed. The OTP is just a string. If you can send a password, you can send an OTP.
Both USB and NFC-enabled YubiKeys are supported.
The library supports NFC-enabled YubiKeys and provides the APIs to request an OTP (Yubico OTP or HOTP) from the NFC YubiKeys using a NFC-enabled iOS device.
